description: This file defines the CustomField model class within the Opencart Admin module for handling operations related to custom fields such as adding, editing, deleting, and retrieving custom field data, descriptions, customer groups, and values.

classes.name: CustomField
classes.description: Model class for managing custom fields and their related descriptions, customer groups, and values in the OpenCart admin system.

methods.name: addCustomField
methods.description: Inserts a new custom field record into the database, including its descriptions, customer group associations, and values, then returns the ID of the newly created custom field.

methods.name: editCustomField
methods.description: Updates an existing custom field's data, descriptions, customer group associations, and values based on its ID.

methods.name: deleteCustomField
methods.description: Deletes a custom field and all its related descriptions, customer groups, and values from the database.

methods.name: getCustomField
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific custom field including its description in the current language.

methods.name: getCustomFields
methods.description: Fetches a list of custom fields possibly filtered by various parameters such as name, status, location, customer group, with sorting and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalCustomFields
methods.description: Returns the total number of custom fields in the database.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Adds a description for a custom field in a specific language.

methods.name: deleteDescriptions
methods.description: Removes all descriptions associated with a specific custom field.

methods.name: deleteDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Removes all descriptions that belong to a specific language across all custom fields.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Retrieves descriptions for a specific custom field across all languages.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Retrieves all custom field descriptions for a specific language.

methods.name: addCustomerGroup
methods.description: Associates a custom field with a customer group, optionally marking it as required.

methods.name: deleteCustomerGroups
methods.description: Deletes all customer group associations for a specific custom field.

methods.name: getCustomerGroups
methods.description: Fetches all customer group associations for a specific custom field.

methods.name: getCustomerGroups
methods.description: Fetches all customer group associations for a specific custom field.

methods.name: addValue
methods.description: Adds a value (option) for a custom field, either inserting a new record or updating an existing one.

methods.name: deleteValues
methods.description: Deletes all values associated with a specific custom field.

methods.name: addValue
methods.description: Inserts a new value (option) for a custom field into the database along with its descriptions, then returns the ID of the newly created custom field value.

methods.name: deleteValues
methods.description: Deletes all values associated with a specific custom field and its descriptions.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific custom field value, including its description in the current language.

methods.name: getValues
methods.description: Fetches all values for a specific custom field, returning an array of value data with descriptions and sort order.

methods.name: addValueDescription
methods.description: Adds a description to a custom field value in a specific language.

methods.name: deleteValueDescriptions
methods.description: Removes all descriptions for a specific custom field value.

methods.name: deleteValueDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Removes all value descriptions that belong to a specific language across all custom field values.

methods.name: getValueDescriptions
methods.description: Retrieves descriptions for a specific custom field value across all languages.

methods.name: getValueDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Fetches all custom field value descriptions associated with a specific language.
